marta: Heads-up: opened PR #2812 to add SDK migration examples for the new Private auth flow. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2812. Assigning @josh for tech review and @priya for copy. CI preview failed on linkcheck + markdownlint + vale. Please hold on merge.

ci-bot: CI report for PR #2812 — failing checks: linkcheck, markdownlint, vale. Re-run with '/retest'.

marta: Failing output (paste):
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/auth/private-auth.md -> broken link: https://partner.example.com/auth-guide (404)
MARKDOWNLINT WARN: docs/auth/private-auth.md: sdk snippet fence missing language (``` instead of ```javascript)
VALE FAIL: docs/auth/private-auth.md:34 — VALE[Clarity] 'we recommend' flagged (prefer direct instruction)
SPELLCHECK NOTE: 'onprem' -> 'on-prem' (docs/auth/private-auth.md:10)
```

josh: I'll replace the external partner link with our KB canonical path and add a short inline snippet for the auth handshake so readers don't hit the 404. Will avoid touching SDK snippet formatting because infra-integrations pins samples.

priya: I'll change 'we recommend' -> 'Use' and remove passive constructions. Also add `javascript` to the code fence and run Vale locally for a quick pass.

marta: Quick procedural Qs: 1) Will preview rebuild automatically after commits? 2) Merge window today is 12:15 PT  can we aim for that?

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit 7c4d3 added by josh. Docs preview queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2812

ci-bot: Docs preview completed — linkcheck PASS, markdownlint FAIL (1), vale FAIL (1).

priya: The remaining markdownlint is a missing language tag I missed in an 'advanced' snippet. Pushing a tiny commit to add `javascript` and one-line Vale tweak (replace 'we recommend' with 'Use'). I preserved snippet whitespace exactly where infra pins it.

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit d2b8f6 pushed by priya. Docs preview started: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2812

ci-bot: Docs preview passed — all checks green.

marta: All green. Plan: merge at 12:15 PT in the docs merge window unless anyone objects. Note: PR description updated with KB cross-ref and a short note about preserving snippet formatting for downstream pins.

josh: Tech LGTM  only doc-only and KB link changes.

priya: Style LGTM. Kept snippet semantics identical.

marta: Merging at 12:15 PT (squash) if no objections. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
